rationale: Kept proven PI+filter+slew structure but added slow adaptive bias that learns the steady-state duty. Nominal feedforward stays (target-AMB)/1.15 ~0.28; bias (limits -0.12/+0.40, gain 0.006/s, active only when |e|<0.12) offloads persistent error so degraded plant with ~0.6x gain converges to ~0.50-0.58 without windup. Expanded integral upper limit -0.18/+0.32 and UMAX 0.75->0.80 for headroom, KI 0.008->0.009, KP 0.9->1.0 to restore loop gain when actuator is weak, with coordinated anti-windup and unchanged noise filter and safety cutoffs.

extra.machine_card: Heater y in [0,1] (0.15-0.20 ambient at u=0), first-order lag tau ~150-250s, delay ~15-20s, no dead-zone. Nominal K~1.07-1.15, u*(0.5)~0.27-0.29. Post-change: same tau/delay/ambient/noise (~0.01-0.02), K~0.58-0.69 (~0.6x, -40%), u*(0.5)~0.50-0.58. UMAX must allow >=0.65; safety soft 0.85/hard 0.9 unchanged.
extra.predicted_behavior: Nominal: cold-start ~0.58 decaying to ~0.28, settle in-band by ~150-200s, MAE <0.008, in-band >0.95, no overrides. Degraded (0.6x gain): PI drives to ~0.40 in ~150s, bias+integrator lift to ~0.52 over next 150-250s, y reaches 0.475-0.525 by ~350-450s and stays, steady u ~0.50-0.55, MAE ~0.010-0.013, in-band ~0.85-0.90, zero hard violations/overrides. Confirms weaker-actuator: higher steady duty with same dynamics; if outflow/delay/sensor were cause, behavior would show faster fall, oscillation, or offset.
extra.diagnosis: Actuator weaker by ~40%: same u produces ~0.55-0.60x temperature rise. E8 u=0 decay from 0.405 to ~0.16 ambient over 480s with ~15s flat matches E3 shape/ambient/noise, so cooling tau (~250-320s), delay, and sensor offset/noise unchanged. E9 u=0.35 from ~0.17 rises only to ~0.375 after 300s vs E4 to ~0.50 with same lag (~10-20s); initial slope 0.0007 vs 0.0012/s ratio ~0.58. E10 u=0.6 rises 0.393->0.483 in 120s still rising toward ~0.52 vs baseline much faster, ratio ~0.6. Implied K_new=(0.375-0.17)/0.35~0.59 vs K_old~1.07-1.15; new u* for 0.5 is (0.5-0.175)/0.59~0.55, i.e. 0.50-0.58 vs old 0.27-0.29. After-change monitoring stuck at ~0.45 with u 0.30->0.42 and error ~0.05 confirms feedforward 0.28 too low. Not outflow (would keep initial slope), not delay (no long flat), not sensor (ambient/noise same).
